mailwoman:sources.citation: The union of the Who's On First county records Kabo (1108759675), Batangafo (1108759693), Bouca (1108759695). Each sub-prefecture record is assigned to the prefecture that GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-28. For each of the 20 records, at least 96 percent of those places are under one prefecture.
